data.content: In a world full of noise, assumptions, and chaos, we created Hopinion, a space that helps us stay focused, human, and always up to date.

Our motto is clear: “Assumption is the mother of all mistakes! When assumptions stop, certainty begins.” With this belief, and with the aim of rebuilding trust in market research by making it more transparent, ethical, and deeply human, we created this unique platform.

For a long time, the market research industry has operated behind the scenes, sharing very little about how data is collected, how investments are made, and which methodologies are used. This lack of transparency has inevitably reduced trust, both among clients and among the people whose opinions contribute to the growth and direction of a brand.
Hopinion exists to change this concept. Our mission challenges outdated norms by generating new insights while valuing, respecting, and rewarding people’s opinions.

For individuals who share their opinions, we provide access to their response and choice history, the ability to track rewards, and the opportunity to discover new surveys they qualify for, all through a transparent and user-friendly space. For clients, Hopinion offers direct access to brand surveys, segmented by demographics and/or interests, with real-time results, downloadable reports, and, upon request, customized analysis from our data team.

Hopinion is built from two words: “Hop” and “Opinion.” Although the name may sound playful at first, it carries a deeper meaning. “Hop” refers to movement and progress. Like a bunny hop, it symbolizes the act of leaping from one decision to the next. These are well-informed leaps, guided by the voices of many, hence “Opinion,” which reflects the core of what we collect and analyze: people’s perspectives, shared transparently and honestly.

Founded by Karrota, a creative and communication agency operating in Kosovo and Albania, Hopinion is supported by years of experience in strategic marketing and communication, combined with extensive hands-on research fieldwork.

The logo features a rabbit (connecting it to Karrota’s identity) captured mid-hop, symbolizing movement and progress. This single moment reflects speed and growth. Minimal and bold lines convey a clean, simple logo without unnecessary elements, perfectly aligned with the core concept of Hopinion.
